## Beyond the Classroom

This section contains optional resources for students who want to explore astronomy further. None of this material is required, but you might find it interesting!

## Astronomy in the News

*Links to recent discoveries and news articles will be posted here.*

## Videos & Documentaries

- **[Astronomy Videos](astro-videos.qmd)** — Curated videos organized by topic (start here!)
- [ESO Public Videos](https://www.eso.org/public/videos/) — Stunning footage from the European Southern Observatory

## Beautiful Images

- [ESA Webb Image Gallery](https://esawebb.org/images/) — Latest images from the James Webb Space Telescope

## Interactive Tools

- **[Cosmic Playground](https://astrobytes-edu.github.io/cosmic-playground/)** — Our custom-built interactive demos for this course (blackbody radiation, EM spectrum, Kepler's laws, and more)
- **[ViewSpace Interactives](https://viewspace.org)** (NASA/STScI) — Explore how different wavelengths reveal the invisible universe
  - [Infrared Animals](https://viewspace.org/interactives/unveiling_invisible_universe/forms_of_light/infrared_animals) — Slide between visible and infrared to see how thermal radiation reveals hidden heat
  - [Spectrum of the Star Altair](https://viewspace.org/interactives/unveiling_invisible_universe/analyzing_light/spectrum_of_the_star_altair) — Walk through how astronomers spread starlight into a spectrum and interpret it

## Useful Resources

- [NASA Universe](https://science.nasa.gov/universe/) — NASA's portal for all things cosmic
- [NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day](https://apod.nasa.gov/)
- [ESA/Hubble Image Archive](https://esahubble.org/images/)
- [JWST Image Gallery](https://webbtelescope.org/images)
- [Astrobites](https://astrobites.org)
